speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe your symptoms, specifically how long you have had diarrhea and if there is any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have had watery diarrhea for the last two days, with at least nine episodes, but there is no blood or mucus in my stool. I am also experiencing lower abdominal discomfort and cramping. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a fever, and have you recently traveled or consumed any potentially contaminated food or water? I also need to know if you are experiencing any signs of dehydration, such as dry mouth or decreased urination.

speaker: Patient
text: No, I do not have a fever, and I haven't traveled or eaten anything unusual recently. I haven't noticed any signs of dehydration like dry mouth or decreased urination either. I want to emphasize that, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the acute onset of watery diarrhea without fever, blood, or travel history, this is most consistent with acute viral gastroenteritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Viral Gastroenteritis
